title: PEOPLES FINANCIAL SERVICES CORP. Declares Third Quarter 2026 Dividend
summary: The Board of Directors of Peoples Financial Services Corp. ("Peoples") (NASDAQ: PFIS) declared a third quarter cash dividend of $0.6250 per share. The dividend is payable September 15, 2026 to shareholders of record August 31, 2026.
